EQUIPMENT FINANCE LEASE

Lease No. EFL-2026-118

Lessor: Kestrel Capital Equipment Finance, LLC, 400 Marquette Avenue, Minneapolis, MN 55401
Lessee: Ridgeline Precision Machining, Inc., 2255 Industrial Parkway, Waukesha, WI 53186

1. Lease of Equipment. Lessor leases to Lessee the equipment described on Schedule A (the "Equipment"). Lessee has selected the Equipment and the supplier and acknowledges that Lessor is not the manufacturer or supplier.

2. Term and Rent. The lease term is sixty (60) months commencing on the Acceptance Date. Lessee shall pay rent of $4,180.00 per month in advance on the first day of each month. Rent is payable without notice, demand, abatement, setoff, counterclaim or deduction of any kind.

3. NET LEASE; HELL OR HIGH WATER. THIS IS A NET LEASE. LESSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY RENT IS ABSOLUTE AND UNCONDITIONAL AND SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO ANY ABATEMENT, REDUCTION, SETOFF, DEFENSE, COUNTERCLAIM OR RECOUPMENT FOR ANY REASON WHATSOEVER, INCLUDING ANY FAILURE OF THE EQUIPMENT TO PERFORM.

4. Disclaimer. LESSOR MAKES NO WARRANTY, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. LESSEE LEASES THE EQUIPMENT "AS IS."

5. Insurance. Lessee shall maintain property insurance on the Equipment for its full replacement value and commercial general liability insurance naming Lessor as additional insured.

6. Default and Remedies. Lessee is in default if any rent is not paid when due. Upon default Lessor may declare all remaining rent for the entire term immediately due and payable, repossess the Equipment without notice or legal process, and recover its costs and attorneys' fees. Lessee waives any right to notice, hearing, or redemption.

7. Assignment. Lessor may assign this Lease without notice to Lessee. Lessee may not assign or sublease without Lessor's prior written consent.

8. Governing Law; Venue. This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of Minnesota. Lessee consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Hennepin County, Minnesota, and waives any objection to venue and any right to trial by jury.

9. End of Term. At the end of the term Lessee shall purchase the Equipment for one dollar ($1.00).

LESSOR: Kestrel Capital Equipment Finance, LLC     LESSEE: Ridgeline Precision Machining, Inc.
